reasons.paused: This campaign is not delivering right now.
reasons.no_spend: It has spent almost nothing for {days} days; the system is not delivering it.
reasons.collecting: Just started. Not enough data yet, let it run a few days.
reasons.no_creatives: No creative can deliver (rejected, unavailable or needs authorization).
reasons.learning_after_change: ROI or budget changed recently. TikTok needs at least 3 days to re-learn; changing it now only disrupts it.
reasons.learning_new: New campaign still in its learning period; swings in the first 3 days are normal.
reasons.losing_protected: 7-day ROI {roi} is below break-even {breakEven}. But today has more than 20 orders and ROI below 90% of target, so ROI protection applies and TikTok will refund the gap as ad credit.
reasons.losing_max_delivery: This campaign uses Max delivery (no ROI target). 7-day ROI {roi} is below break-even {breakEven}; every extra dollar loses money.
reasons.losing_target_low: 7-day ROI {roi} is below break-even {breakEven}: the more you sell, the more you lose. The target ROI {target} is set below break-even.
reasons.losing_target_ok: Target ROI {target} is already above break-even but the actual 7-day ROI is only {roi}: the product's conversion or margin can't support it.
reasons.underspend: Only {utilization}% of budget used in 7 days while ROI {roi} already meets target {target}. Unspent budget usually means the ROI target is too tight.
reasons.underspend_at_floor: Only {utilization}% of budget used, but the target ROI is already near break-even and can't go lower. Better creatives or a stronger offer are needed.
reasons.scale: {utilization}% of budget used in 7 days with ROI {roi} at or above target {target}. Budget is the ceiling; more budget means more sales.
reasons.scale_max_delivery: Budget almost fully spent under Max delivery and ROI {roi} is above break-even; raise budget in small steps.
reasons.creatives_blocked: {blocked} creatives are blocked (authorization needed, rejected or unavailable) and can't deliver.
reasons.creatives_few: Only {delivering} creatives are delivering; at least {need} are recommended for the system to find winners.
reasons.healthy: ROI above target and budget use is normal; about {profitPerDay} profit per day.
reasons.healthy_low_volume: No problems found yet, but orders are still few. Keep watching.

lines.aria: Break-even ROI {breakEven}, target ROI {target}, actual ROI {actual}

daily_rhythm.title: Check three times a day
daily_rhythm.oneLine: Morning: set direction. Daytime: watch pace. Evening: refill creatives.
daily_rhythm.why: GMV Max is fully automated; frequent edits interrupt learning. Grouping actions at fixed times catches problems without over-editing.
how: 9:00: review yesterday's full data and do today's must-dos (raise ROI only at this time)
Daytime: only react to spending too fast or too slow; raise budget or lower ROI, never raise ROI
20:00: fix blocked creatives and add new videos

break_even.title: Break-even ROI decides everything
break_even.oneLine: Break-even ROI = 1 / margin. Below it you lose money.
break_even.why: GMV Max ROI = gross revenue / ad cost. With a 40% margin after product, shipping and commissions, you can spend at most 40 per 100 of sales, i.e. ROI 2.5. Below 2.5 every sale loses money.
how: Enter your store margin (before ads) in settings
Set target ROI around break-even x 1.15 for a 15% safety buffer
Never set target ROI below break-even
break_even.sourceName: Third party: GMV Max best practices

learning_period.title: Wait 3 days after each change
learning_period.oneLine: After changing ROI or budget, wait at least 3 full days.
learning_period.why: Each change makes the system re-explore traffic; early swings are normal. Reverting because of a swing means it never finishes learning.
how: Click "I changed it" so the 3-day countdown starts
Blue "Learning" campaigns should not be touched
After 3 days judge with 7-day rolling data
learning_period.sourceName: TikTok: Best practices for LIVE GMV Max

underspend_roi.title: Unspent budget = ROI too high
underspend_roi.oneLine: Budget unspent while ROI is on target usually means the target is too tight.
underspend_roi.why: In Target ROI mode the budget is only a ceiling; the target is the traffic filter. Too high a filter leaves no eligible traffic. TikTok recommends lowering the target slightly when spend is slow.
how: Lower by about 10% each time
At most once per day (lowering twice voids that day's ROI protection)
Never below break-even x 1.05
If it still won't spend at the floor, the issue is creatives or the offer
underspend_roi.sourceName: TikTok: Best practices for LIVE GMV Max

scale_budget.title: Scale at most 30% a day
scale_budget.oneLine: Budget used above 80–90% with ROI on target: raise the budget.
scale_budget.why: High utilization means the budget is capping profitable traffic. TikTok recommends gradual increases of up to 30% per day; a short ROI dip afterwards is normal.
how: Add 30% at a time, never double
Wait 3 days and check ROI stays above target
Stop raising when ROI falls below target

roi_protection.title: ROI protection: don't lose the credit
roi_protection.oneLine: If a day's ROI is below 90% of target with more than 20 orders, TikTok refunds the gap.
roi_protection.why: Credit = day cost minus day revenue / (target ROI x 0.9). You lose it that day if you manually raise the target, lower it more than once, pause or delete the campaign, or edit products. Max delivery and Creative Boost spend are not covered.
how: Raise ROI first thing in the morning and accept losing that day's protection
If today already qualifies, don't touch it
In TikTok, hover the "ROI protected" badge and choose View history (60 days kept)

creative_supply.title: More creatives, more winners
creative_supply.oneLine: Keep enough deliverable videos and add new ones regularly.
creative_supply.why: GMV Max tests all eligible creatives and then concentrates budget on the best. More testable creatives make winners easier to find. TikTok Shop University suggests at least 40 delivering short videos for Product GMV Max; LIVE needs 50–70 per session or 5–10 new per day.
how: Fix blocked creatives first (authorization, rejected, unavailable)
Add new videos weekly: new hooks, creators, demos
Send your best creative to AI Producer for variations
Use Accelerate testing or Creative Boost when needed
creative_supply.sourceName: TikTok: Improve creative exploration in Product GMV Max

blockers.title: Rule out blockers first
blockers.oneLine: No spend? Check balance, products and authorization before ROI.
blockers.why: More budget can't fix an unavailable product or unauthorized videos. TikTok lists 9 creative statuses; authorization needed, rejected, unavailable and excluded can't deliver, and rejected videos may still spend.
how: Check the ad account balance
Make sure products are on sale with stock
Authorize videos that need it (takes about 20 minutes)
Replace or appeal rejected videos; restore wrongly excluded ones
blockers.sourceName: TikTok: Metrics in GMV Max reports

max_delivery.title: Max delivery is for bursts only
max_delivery.oneLine: Target ROI is the default; Max delivery is for launches, clearance and big sales.
max_delivery.why: Max delivery spends the budget without an ROI guarantee. TikTok suggests 3–5 days of Max delivery for new shops or products with at least 10x AOV daily budget, and 1–5x normal spend during big sales; above 5x ROI may drop sharply. Max delivery spend isn't covered by ROI protection.
how: New product: 3–5 days of Max delivery, then switch to Target ROI
Big sale: at most 5x normal spend
ROI below break-even: switch back to Target ROI

seven_day_rolling.title: Look at 7 days, not yesterday
seven_day_rolling.oneLine: All verdicts use 7-day rolling data to avoid single-day noise.
seven_day_rolling.why: Daily ROI swings. Judging trends on 7-day data plus the learning period gives stable decisions. Product and creative cost can lag up to 11 hours and their orders include organic sales, so verdicts use campaign-level data only.
how: Use "Actual (7d)" ROI, not yesterday's
Watch one-off anomalies before acting
Use product and creative data to find creative issues, not to judge profit
seven_day_rolling.sourceName: TikTok: Metrics in GMV Max reports (latency notes)

setup.title: Step 1: enter one margin (30 seconds)
setup.desc: Margin = what's left of the price after product cost, shipping, platform and creator commission (before ads). It lets the system tell whether each campaign makes or loses money. A rough value is fine; change it anytime.
